heading: INT. ABANDONED CANNERY - PROCESSING FLOOR - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED CANNERY - PROCESSING FLOOR - NIGHT
A hangar of rust and rain.
Long steel conveyors run the length of the building like the ribs of a drowned whale.
Windows are blind with salt.
Somewhere beneath the planks, the tide breathes in and out through broken pilings, and the whole floor sighs with it.
A string of work lights, powered by a coughing generator outside, strings pale yellow beads down the aisle.
A documentary crew has made camp among the vats.
Six people, six camp chairs, a scatter of cables.
IVO HARTLEY-SPAN, fifties, director, a vast man in a linen coat, sits with a clipboard balanced on his belly.
PUSHPA RANA, thirties, sound recordist, holds a boom mic like a fishing rod and listens to the dark with half-closed eyes.
LEOPOLDO MENDES, twenties, camera operator, wipes a lens with a spotless cloth he has wiped it with already.
QUILLA ASHFORD, thirties, producer, has a phone pressed to her ear and a frown carved between her brows.
CEDRIC FAIRBANKS, sixties, the historian, wears a tweed cap and quotes from a leather notebook.
MAEVE O'DWYER, forties, the local guide, stands apart with her arms crossed, looking at nothing.
Let's roll on the long shot. Leo, can you keep the conveyor in frame?
units.name: IVO

units.text: It's in frame.
units.name: LEOPOLDO

units.text: Beautiful. Pushpa?
units.name: IVO

units.text: Room tone's good. There's a hum.
units.name: PUSHPA

units.text: The generator?
units.name: IVO

units.text: Lower.
units.name: PUSHPA

units.text: Ivo lowers the clipboard.
Pushpa tilts the boom toward the floorboards, then toward the rafters, then back to the floor, as if tracking a small animal.
Leopoldo pans slowly across the vats, and Cedric, noticing the lens, straightens his cap and clears his throat for the camera.
Quilla drops the phone into her lap and rubs her eyes with the heel of her hand.
No signal. Again.
units.name: QUILLA

units.text: "The Hallam Cannery closed in nineteen fifty-three, following an accident on the lower line in which nine workers were lost."
units.name: CEDRIC

units.text: Eleven.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: I beg your pardon?
units.name: CEDRIC

units.text: Eleven were lost. Nine is what the paper said.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Cedric blinks.
He flips the page of his notebook, finds nothing to correct her, and closes it.
Local knowledge. Invaluable.
units.name: CEDRIC

units.text: It isn't knowledge. It's my grandmother.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Maeve, would you be willing to say that on camera?
units.name: IVO

units.text: Not tonight.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Tomorrow, then.
units.name: IVO

units.text: We won't be here tomorrow.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Silence.
The tide sighs under the floor.
The generator coughs outside, catches, coughs again.
Pushpa turns slowly and looks at Maeve over the boom.
Why not?
units.name: PUSHPA

units.text: Because nobody stays past three.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: That's marvellous. We'll put that in the trailer.
units.name: QUILLA

units.text: What happens at three?
units.name: LEOPOLDO

units.text: Nothing. That's what they say. Nothing happens.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Ivo sets the clipboard on the floor.
He rises with an effort, takes a torch from his bag, and walks to the nearest conveyor.
He runs the beam along its length.
Rust.
Dust.
A single glove, small, stiff, grey with age.
Well. Somebody's been here.
units.name: IVO

units.text: He bends to pick it up.
Before his fingers touch it, the work lights flicker.
Cedric steadies his cap.
Quilla stands.
Pushpa lowers the boom.
Leopoldo turns the camera toward the dark end of the hall, and for a long moment all six of them listen to the building listening back.
The lights steady.
Nothing has changed.
Only the glove, now, is on the other side of the conveyor.
Did anyone see that move?
units.name: LEOPOLDO

units.text: Nobody answers.
Ivo straightens, wipes his hand on his coat, and walks back to his chair with the careful tread of a man pretending not to hurry.
Right. Let's get the interviews done by two.
units.name: IVO

units.text: Two?
units.name: CEDRIC

units.text: Just in case.
units.name: IVO

units.text: Maeve looks at him for the first time with something like approval.
Quilla sits.
Pushpa lifts the boom.
The hum of the generator rises, falls, rises again, like breath.
